quest.title: Clean and Healthy
quest.description: Golshan of Bimarstan is worrying about the sanitation conditions in the hospital...

dialogues.speaker: Golshan
dialogues.text: *sigh* How will we find anyone who will help at this hour...

dialogues.speaker: Golshan
dialogues.text: Oh! H—Hello there, Traveler. Are you here for treatment?

response.speaker: Golshan
response.text: Hehe... Was it that obvious? Well, you are right. I am worried about something.

response.speaker: Golshan
response.text: I don't know why, but there's been an increasing number of people seeking treatment here at Bimarstan lately. Our staff have their hands full taking care of the patients.

response.speaker: Golshan
response.text: Still, Dr. Zakariya insisted that I find ways to keep the surrounding area clean...

response.speaker: Golshan
response.text: He said that only if the hospital and patients were kept clean, then they could more easily receive the blessing of the Dendro Archon.

response.speaker: Golshan
response.text: *sigh* But we can't spare any hands at the moment, and it's not like I can ask the patients with mild symptoms to help out...

choices.text: How about you leave the cleaning to me?

response.speaker: Golshan
response.text: You'll help? That's very kind of you! I'll have the payment ready. It's just that... you might have to lower your expectations in that regard.

response.speaker: Golshan
response.text: *sigh* May the Dendro Archon keep people safe from sickness...

response.speaker: Golshan
response.text: Few would volunteer to work in a place full of patients. Besides, we don't have the budget to hire that many people.

response.speaker: Golshan
response.text: Normally we would split the cleaning into shifts, but no one is available right now.

response.speaker: Golshan
response.text: So, Traveler, could... could you help out?

response.speaker: Golshan
response.text: We will pay you! It won't be too much though...

response.speaker: Player
response.text: What's with the patients here, anyway...

response.speaker: Golshan
response.text: Most of our patients only suffer from minor ailments, such as headaches.

response.speaker: Golshan
response.text: Dr. Zakariya has told people many times that these conditions are not as scary as they think, but no one buys his explanations.

response.speaker: Golshan
response.text: I suppose that it might not be the disease they're afraid of, it's getting sick itself...

response.speaker: Golshan
response.text: I'll leave the cleaning to you then, Traveler.

choices.text: I just noticed that you looked so worried...

dialogues.speaker: Golshan
dialogues.text: Have you cleaned up the surrounding area?

dialogues.speaker: Golshan
dialogues.text: I can't thank you enough, Traveler. Please take this as your payment.

dialogues.speaker: Golshan
dialogues.text: By the way, Mr. Gurgen has been forcing himself to work again lately. I should take some more time to get him to change his mind...

dialogues.speaker: Golshan
dialogues.text: There have been so many things that need taking care of lately, so I might have to bother you with cleanup duties next time as well.

dialogues.speaker: Golshan
dialogues.text: Traveler, is there anything you'd like to ask?

choices.text: Could you tell me more about Zakariya?

response.speaker: Golshan
response.text: Dr. Zakariya is a great doctor and a devout believer of the Dendro Archon.

response.speaker: Golshan
response.text: He treats patients around the clock and hardly ever has time to eat.

response.speaker: Golshan
response.text: Dr. Zakariya even said that it's his duty to extend the blessings of the Dendro Archon to more people.

choices.text: Does the blessing of the Dendro Archon really matter that much in healing?

response.speaker: Golshan
response.text: To be precise, the act of "treatment" itself is the blessing of the Dendro Archon.

response.speaker: Golshan
response.text: It was by the grace of the Dendro Archon that we could find cures for patients and grow herbs to treat illnesses...

response.speaker: Golshan
response.text: Thank you, O Dendro Archon, for your blessing. May everyone be kept from maladies...

dialogues.speaker: Golshan
dialogues.text: Have you cleaned up the surrounding area?

dialogues.speaker: Golshan
dialogues.text: I can't thank you enough, Traveler. Please take this as your payment.

dialogues.speaker: Golshan
dialogues.text: By the way, Mr. Aftab hasn't been following his diet lately. I'll have to discuss his medication with Dr. Zakariya...

dialogues.speaker: Golshan
dialogues.text: There have been so many things that need taking care of lately, so I might have to bother you with cleanup duties next time as well.

dialogues.speaker: Golshan
dialogues.text: Have you cleaned up the surrounding area?

dialogues.speaker: Golshan
dialogues.text: I can't thank you enough, Traveler. Please take this as your payment.

dialogues.speaker: Golshan
dialogues.text: By the way, Ms. Azra seems a little down lately. Should I ask her about the situation or not...?

dialogues.speaker: Golshan
dialogues.text: There have been so many things that need taking care of lately, so I might have to bother you with cleanup duties next time as well.
